note: The trip chat's tools: the change agent's read and check tools (descriptions from the agent's tool file), plus suggest_revision. No tool here changes, drafts, sends, or approves anything.

tools.name: suggest_revision
tools.description: Suggest instructions for revising an open change, shown to the trip manager as a button. Nothing changes unless the trip manager clicks it; then the change agent revises the package and every check runs again.

change_id.description: The open change to revise, e.g. chg-006. Must be waiting for the trip manager's decision.

instructions.description: What the change agent should do, written the way the trip manager would put it.
